title: Wishes and Regrets
description: Expressing wishes with хотел бы and regrets with жаль
intro: Russian uses conditional constructions to express wishes and regrets politely. WISHES: Я хотел бы... (I would like...) is more polite than Я хочу. Хотелось бы (impersonal) is even softer. REGRETS: Жаль, что... (It's a pity that...) expresses disappointment. Жаль, что не... for things that didn't happen. For past regrets: Надо было + infinitive (should have). These constructions are essential for polite, native-sounding Russian.
rules: Я хотел(а) бы + infinitive = I would like to (polite wish): Я хотел бы заказать кофе.
Мне хотелось бы + infinitive = I would like to (softer): Мне хотелось бы узнать...
Жаль, что + clause = It's a pity that: Жаль, что ты не пришёл.
Надо было + infinitive = should have: Надо было позвонить раньше. (I should have called earlier.)
examples: Я хотел бы поговорить с директором. (I would like to speak with the director.), polite request
Мне хотелось бы побывать в Японии. (I would like to visit Japan.), soft wish
Жаль, что он уехал. (It's a pity he left.), regret
Надо было сказать ему правду. (I/We should have told him the truth.), past regret

items.promptEnglish: It's a pity we didn't make it.

items.prompt: _____ позвонить ему вчера. (I should have called him yesterday.)
items.promptEnglish: I should have called him yesterday.
items.hint: Past regret (should have) → надо было + infinitive

items.prompt: Мне _____ узнать ваше мнение. (I would like to know your opinion.)
items.promptEnglish: I would like to know your opinion.

items.promptEnglish: It's a pity the weather is so bad.

items.promptEnglish: I should have taken an umbrella.
items.hint: Past necessity not fulfilled → надо было

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Soft polite wish: мне хотелось бы + infinitive
hints: Dative 'мне' + impersonal = soft wish. Which form?
Я + personal form = polite request. Which form?
Expressing disappointment about a past event. Which word?
Expressing regret about not doing something. Which construction?
explanations: Softest wish: мне хотелось бы + infinitive (impersonal).
Polite personal wish: я хотел бы + infinitive.
Жаль expresses pity/regret about a situation.
Надо было + infinitive expresses 'should have done' (past obligation).
